description.narrative: On Nov 3, 2023, earthquake with a magnitude of 6.4 struck the western region of Nepal, specifically in the Karnali province. The epicenter was located in Ramidanda, Jajarkot district. Several aftershocks occurred, causing significant distress among the local population. These aftershocks (as of 08.11.23) have compelled residents to evacuate their homes and shelter in open areas, with experts warning of the possibility of a major aftershock in the affected areas. It was reported as 158 people have died, with 13,705 households affected and 12,060 households displaced. 9,483 houses have been fully destroyed and a further 19,286 partially destroyed. (Red Cross SitRep).Nepal Earthquake Response project is implemented in partnership with RRN Nepal in Jajarkot and Rukum districts of Nepal.

Outcome: Earthquake-affected individuals in the Jajarkot and West Rukum districts have received immediate humanitarian support and are well-prepared to meet their winter needs and are prepared for early recovery.

Participants will be selected based on the assessment report and in close coordination with local government. The specific needs of the highly vulnerable or socially excluded populations will be assessed through focus group discussion, data of the Initial Rapid Assessment (and detail assessment report will be used, coordination with the local government). Assistance packages will be specifically designed to accommodate the different needs or men, women, girls, and boys. Additionally, both Rural Reconstruction Nepal's(Implementing partner) links to the target communities, and their expertise in supporting hard to reach areas, will help ensure that particularly vulnerable people of any gender, in addition to people with disabilities will have access to the support. Rural Reconstruction Nepal has demonstrated its capacity to deliver gender and age-sensitive assistance. The total targeted participants is 9750 (Male-4810 and Female - 4940).
